Rule v5 — class review cards (vendors propose, depth decides)

Built 2026-11-06T10:41:40-06:00, read-only. 55 cards, 5 per class for every change class of >= 20 wells, drawn at random (seed 51106) from wells that are not labelled, overridden or on any earlier card. Gate per class: 5/5 accepts, 0-1/5 rejects, otherwise 5 more and 7/10. Neighbours are evidence wells only by their LIVE tags. A card whose plain-median check disagrees with the call is marked, not dropped. Mark cards_sample.csv: agree / reject / a bench code / free text (a hold). Nothing is applied.
